name: @max-health-inc/fhir-igs
description: Publisher for the org's shared FHIR IG packages (@max-health-inc/fhir-*).

comments.babelfhir-ts: Deliberately NOT a dependency here. This repo always publishes with the LATEST released babelfhir-ts, resolved once per run in .github/workflows/publish.yml and passed to both the matrix builder and the generator. A declaration in this file would be a second, stale source of truth for the version.
